title: Classify the failed reviewer password-reset mail delivery without replaying reset or sending mail
acceptance: diagnostic is owner-only and bound to issue 3072 and source reset run 31667978433
source reset run 31667978433 independently proved API and web OCI revision d2dd7972105cc59002263455b5ae0eb8d8f2d386 before the ordinary reset POST returned HTTP 202
diagnostic determines the active compose project read-only, then searches only retained historical web container records in that same project
exactly one retained web container with OCI revision d2dd7972105cc59002263455b5ae0eb8d8f2d386 must exist or the diagnostic fails closed without exposing container identifiers
diagnostic reads only the exact 2026-08-13T04:45:10Z..04:45:24Z retained historical web container log window where the source reset executed
exactly one password_reset_delivery_result event must exist in the bounded window or the diagnostic fails closed
current running production revision may have advanced after the source reset; the diagnostic must neither require rollback to d2dd nor mutate the current runtime
the source deployed revision must remain an ancestor of exact current main throughout the run
successful classification may expose only retained-container cardinality, delivered flag, final provider and whitelist-derived reason classes
failed classification may expose only a whitelisted failure substage plus ZERO, ONE, MULTIPLE or UNKNOWN retained-container and delivery-event cardinality classes
reviewer identity, account hash, correlation id, reset token, container id, image name, raw reason and raw runtime log line must never be published
the diagnostic sends no email, replays no password reset, executes no database command, starts/stops/removes no container and mutates no production state
SSH accepts exactly one host key matching the protected SHA-256 fingerprint and keeps StrictHostKeyChecking=yes
